title: Cursor does not expand `${DOCS_API_KEY}`; its syntax is `${env:DOCS_API_KEY}`, so the literal string is passed as the API key
evidence: Cursor's mcp.json interpolation uses `${env:NAME}` (plus `${workspaceFolder}`, `${userHome}`). The bare `${NAME}` form belongs to Claude Code's `.mcp.json`. The sibling file .vscode/mcp.json:6 uses `${env:LINT_TOKEN}`, so the repo already uses the right form for VS Code and the Claude form was copied into the Cursor file. Traced against the documented syntax. I could not run Cursor.
failing_case: A developer exports DOCS_API_KEY and opens the repo in Cursor. The docs server starts with DOCS_API_KEY set to the text `${DOCS_API_KEY}`. Every call to the docs service is rejected, and the value that reaches the vendor's logs is the placeholder, not a key.
remediation: Write `"DOCS_API_KEY": "[redacted]"` in .cursor/mcp.json. Keep the bare `${VAR}` form only in .mcp.json for Claude Code.
fix: not offerable: the fix is the same as the code

title: `search` is a stdio server (uvx) but its token is set as `headers`, which stdio servers do not use
evidence: .mcp.json:14-18. The entry has `command` and `args`, so Claude Code starts it as a local stdio process. `headers` is an option of HTTP and SSE entries (`type`/`url`). A stdio process has no HTTP request to attach a header to, and the config has no `env` block, so SEARCH_TOKEN is never passed to the process. .claude/settings.json:2 enables `search`, so it does start. I traced the config shape only. I did not start Claude Code against it.
failing_case: A teammate exports SEARCH_TOKEN and opens the project. Claude Code approves and spawns `uvx search-mcp==2.1.0` through the pre-approval in settings.json. The process gets no token. Every authenticated search call fails (or runs unauthenticated), and nothing in the config says why. The author believes the credential is wired up.
remediation: If search-mcp is a local process, pass the token as `"env": {"SEARCH_API_TOKEN": "[redacted]"}` using the variable name the package documents. If the service is remote, switch to `"type": "http"` with a `url` and keep `headers`.
